top_signals.title: Kapteyn: Hot Inflation Raises Risk of Fed Hikes Beyond December
top_signals.summary: UBS Chief Economist Arend Kapteyn discusses the Fed’s rate outlook following hotter inflation data, the impact of AI investment and borrowing on bond yields, and why he believes AI fundamentals remain strong despite the recent market selloff. Kapteyn also weighs in on Europe’s economic challenges, competition with China and France’s fiscal outlook. He spoke on Bloomberg Brief. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: World Bank Sees Up to $5 Billion in Possible Loans to Venezuela
top_signals.summary: The World Bank could loan Venezuela as much as $5 billion over the next two years, as the country resumes relations with the Washington-based lender, a top official said.
